server_progression.advancement.root.desc: Join the server world to start the advancement collection.
server_progression.advancement.biomeboun: Local knowledge
Buy a special enchanted book from a villager.
server_progression.advancement.totem_bal: Survive a totem rescue or defeat an evoker that drops a totem.
server_progression.advancement.veiled.de: Wear a mob or player head to disguise yourself as its owner.
server_progression.advancement.toolkit_c: Shoot a tipped arrow into a block to create a potion cloud.
server_progression.advancement.toolkit_f: Combine an item frame with a phantom membrane, then place the invisible frame.
server_progression.advancement.timespeed: Bad weather calls it a night
Go to bed during a thunderstorm and sleep until morning.
server_progression.advancement.biomeboun: The fine print
Buy a villager book with multiple enchantments, including a curse.
A book for the season
Buy a villager book selected for the current season.
server_progression.advancement.totem_bal: Try to use another totem while the previous one is still on cooldown.
Defeat an evoker that drops a Totem of Undying.
server_progression.advancement.veiled_mo: Wear a mob head to disguise yourself as that mob.
server_progression.advancement.veiled_pl: Wear a player head to disguise yourself as its owner.
server_progression.advancement.toolkit_h: Equip a banner as a helmet.
server_progression.advancement.toolkit_c: Hold a clock and look at its time display.
Bind a lodestone compass to another player.
server_progression.advancement.toolkit_d: Change a block state with the Toolkit debug stick.
server_progression.advancement.toolkit_c: Brew a custom potion or fill a bottle from the Toolkit cauldron.
server_progression.advancement.toolkit_a: Tip arrows with a potion in the Toolkit cauldron.
server_progression.advancement.toolkit_w: Wash dye from armor, a banner or a shulker box in a cauldron.
server_progression.advancement.toolkit_h: Pour honey into a cauldron or take it out.
server_progression.advancement.toolkit_p: Sneak and right-click a block while a parrot sits on your shoulder.
server_progression.advancement.toolkit_s: Add Thorns, Knockback or Quick Charge to a shield and trigger its effect in combat.
server_progression.advancement.toolkit_b: Apply Curse of Vanishing to a bundle in an anvil, then take the result.
server_progression.advancement.toolkit_t: Take a trident or mace hit while wearing a turtle shell helmet.
server_progression.advancement.toolkit_s: Get hit by a snow golem snowball.
server_progression.advancement.toolkit_f: Try to glide with an Elytra while burning.
server_progression.advancement.toolkit_t: Trigger the dispenser trap in a jungle temple.
server_progression.advancement.biomeboun: Two in one cover
Buy an enchanted book with two enchantments from a villager.
Supply creates the price
Buy a book with the same enchantment again to trigger a price increase.
Regular customer
Open the villager trade offers after earning a village reputation discount.
Today only
Open the villager trade offers during the daily sale to see the discount.
After the eighth purchase
Trade with a villager enough times, then open its offers while the special deal is active.
Geography in your pocket
Complete a special trade with a wandering trader.
Career advice
Complete a trade with a villager whose profession offers were changed by the plugin.
server_progression.advancement.toolkit_m: Put a mace and a Mending book in an anvil and try to take the result.
